pivot_priority.instructions: Given a confirmed finding's gained capability and attack path, estimate how likely a further security-boundary crossing exists that is worth actively searching for. This is not a vulnerability taxonomy.

criteria.low: This capability is unlikely to reach a new boundary; a further pivot search is unlikely to be productive.
criteria.standard: This capability may reach a further boundary; a pivot search is worth the standard effort.
criteria.high: This capability is a strong new foothold (e.g. broad server-side reach, credential or token material, administrative control) very likely to cross a further boundary.
